cases.sentence: У сыновей Ноя после ___ тоже родились сыновья.
cases.translation: To the sons of Noah, sons were also born after the flood.
cases.explain: The preposition после (after) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: От них произошли приморские народы и распространились по своим ___.
cases.translation: From them the coastland peoples came and spread through their lands.
cases.explain: The preposition по (over/throughout) governs the dative case (plural).

cases.translation: He was the greatest hunter before the Lord.
cases.explain: The predicate noun with the past tense of быть (был) takes the instrumental case.

cases.translation: He was the greatest hunter before the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before/in front of) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Из той земли он перешёл в ___, где построил Ниневию.
cases.translation: Out of that land he went into Assyria, where he built Nineveh.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Границы Ханаана простирались от Сидона к ___ до Газы.
cases.translation: The borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Первыми городами в его ___ были Вавилон, Эрех, Акат и Халны.
cases.translation: The first cities in his kingdom were Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Куш был отцом ___, который стал могучим воином.
cases.translation: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior.
cases.explain: The noun отец (father of) governs the genitive case for the offspring.

reading.ru: Вот родословия Сима, Хама и Иофета, сыновей Ноя, у которых после потопа тоже родились сыновья.
reading.question: Whose genealogies does this chapter record?
options: Those of Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah
reading.correct: Those of Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah
reading.explain: The text lists the genealogies of Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah.

reading.ru: Первыми городами в его царстве были Вавилон, Эрех, Акат и Халны в Шинаре.
reading.question: Which were the first cities of Nimrod's kingdom?
options: Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in Shinar
reading.correct: Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in Shinar
reading.explain: The text names Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in Shinar as the first cities.

reading.ru: Из той земли он перешел в Асирию, где построил Ниневию, Рихавод-Ир, Калах и Ресен, между Ниневией и Калахом, в Великий город.
reading.question: What did he build after going into Assyria?
reading.explain: The text says that in Assyria he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah, and Resen.

reading.ru: Одного звали Пелек, потому что в его дни земля была разделена, а его брата — Иоктан.
reading.question: Why was one of the sons named Peleg?
options: Because in his days the earth was divided
reading.correct: Because in his days the earth was divided
reading.explain: The text says he was named Peleg because in his days the earth was divided.

reading.ru: Сим был предком всех сыновей Евера.
reading.question: Of whose sons was Shem the ancestor?
options: Of all the sons of Eber
reading.correct: Of all the sons of Eber
reading.explain: The text says Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.

reading.ru: Таковы племена сыновей Ноя по их родословиям в их народах.
reading.question: What does this verse summarize?
options: The clans of the sons of Noah by their genealogies
reading.correct: The clans of the sons of Noah by their genealogies
reading.explain: The text summarizes the clans of the sons of Noah according to their genealogies in their nations.
